Keys.Name: Corpse Detection Radius
Keys.Description: How far away (in world units) a Reanimate spell will search for a valid corpse.

Keys.Name: Limit to Human Corpses
Keys.Description: If enabled, Reanimate spells can only consume human/classed enemy corpses. Off by default.

Keys.Name: Protect Quest Corpses
Keys.Description: If enabled, Reanimate/Corpse Explosion/Deathknell will never consume a corpse tied to an active quest.

Keys.Name: Reanimate Allegiance
Keys.Description: Default Behavior rolls the usual ally-vs-hostile chance. Always Reanimate Allied/Hostile skip that roll entirely and force every reanimation's allegiance.

Keys.Name: Allied Undead Ignore Each Other's Collision
Keys.Description: If enabled, your allied undead pass through each other like they pass through you. Off by default, so a legion physically jostles for space like any other pack of creatures.

Keys.Name: Permanent Undead Summons
Keys.Description: If enabled, reanimated creatures never expire from their duration running out - they only die in combat or are dismissed. Off by default.

Keys.Name: Raise Undead Without Corpse
Keys.Description: If enabled, Reanimate spells no longer require a nearby corpse - the creature rises a few paces in front of you instead. Off by default.

Keys.Name: Necromancy Legal In Towns
Keys.Description: If enabled, casting this mod's necromancy spells while in a town is never treated as a crime.

Keys.Name: Seance Kill Requirement
Keys.Description: How many creatures you must slay since entering the current dungeon before Seance becomes castable there.

Keys.Name: Ignore Seance Kill Requirement
Keys.Description: If enabled, Seance can be cast in any dungeon regardless of how many creatures you've slain there - the kill requirement above is skipped entirely.

Keys.Name: Seance Ghost Speed Multiplier
Keys.Description: Multiplies the Seance ghost's movement speed. Higher values make it easier to keep up with; lower values make it linger longer at each step.

Keys.Name: Seance Wait For Player Distance
Keys.Description: How far behind (in world units) the player can fall before the Seance ghost stops and waits.

Keys.Name: Seance Resume Distance
Keys.Description: How close the player must get to a waiting Seance ghost before it resumes leading the way.

Keys.Name: Mute All Follower Noises
Keys.Description: Master mute for every setting below - if enabled, skeleton/zombie/ghost/wraith/vampire enemies play no idle or attack sounds at all, custom or vanilla, regardless of the other settings in this section.

Keys.Name: Enable Custom Undead Noises
Keys.Description: If enabled, skeleton, zombie, ghost/wraith, and vampire enemies periodically play custom idle ambient sounds, and skeleton/zombie attacks use their custom sound too. If disabled (and Mute All Follower Noises is off), all of these play their normal vanilla sounds instead.

Keys.Name: Funny Mode
Keys.Description: If enabled, adds a set of silly bonus clips to the skeleton/zombie idle rotation and a special vampire-only idle clip. Off by default.

Keys.Name: Idle Sound Interval Min
Keys.Description: Minimum seconds between an undead enemy's idle ambient sounds. Applies to all idle sound pools (skeleton/zombie, ghost/wraith, vampire).

Keys.Name: Idle Sound Interval Max
Keys.Description: Maximum seconds between an undead enemy's idle ambient sounds. Applies to all idle sound pools (skeleton/zombie, ghost/wraith, vampire).
